brief: Custom-fit leather handbags, Italian-made, handcrafted in Florence. Minimum order ships in 6 weeks. Average price point $1,200.

profile.business_summary: A luxury DTC brand offering custom-fit leather handbags that are Italian-made and handcrafted in Florence.

relevant_tags.why: Handbags are a core fashion accessory adjacent to apparel.
High-end luxury handcrafted items can serve as significant gifts.
Handcrafted goods often align with slow fashion and durability.

note_signals.why: Older affluent women with high AOV who respond to quality messaging align well with luxury handbags.
Highest-AOV apparel publisher with a conservative brand sensibility matches luxury Italian craftsmanship.

profile.gate_reason: Product, pricing, and origin are clearly stated, allowing for precise network placement among high-AOV fashion publishers.
clarifying_questions: What is your target demographic by gender?
What is your profit margin or target CPA for this campaign?

pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.43-$0.58 per click (median $0.49), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
